symptom: Clippy reported that path_cost was never used from tests/common/mod.rs, although the UCS and A* integration tests both call it.
rootcause: Cargo compiles every file under tests/ as a separate crate. heuristic_tests.rs also includes common/mod.rs but does not need path_cost, so that one test crate sees the shared helper as dead code.
fix: Added a narrow #[allow(dead_code)] to path_cost with a comment explaining the separate integration-test crates. The helper stays shared by the UCS and A* suites.
notes: This is not dead engine code. The allowance is limited to one test helper, and scripts/verify_invariants.sh keeps Clippy warnings denied everywhere else.
